title.narrative: Supporting Uganda's Tuberculosis Reduction Strategy - Uganda (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Uganda, Tuberculosis, Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development of the Republic of Uganda (MoFPED)This program has the following goals: To reduce the incidence of TB by 5% by 2019/20; that is from 234/100,000 in 2015/16 to 222/100,000 by 2019/20.. The objectives of this program are: To increase case notification rate of incident TB cases from 119/100,000 in 2015/16 to 156/100,00 in 2019/20; and to increase treatment success rate among notified incident cases from 74% in 2015/26 to 85% by 2019/20;. To strengthen TB-HIV integrated care for co-infected patients and increase ART coverage among TB/HIV co-infected patients from 88% in 2015/16 to 95% by 2019/20. To increase case detection rate of drug-resistant TV from 17% in 2015/16 to 51% in 2019/20; and raise TSR from 74% in 2015/16 to 80% by 2019/20.. To strengthen systems for effective management of tuberculosis & leprosy services to meet the NSP targets
